_help: Windows version (10-page turntable) — see 3d-model-step.linux-macos.json for a simpler single-angle Linux/macOS version. STEP files, split out from 3d-model.json: f3d 3.5.0 can't auto-detect the occt STEP reader from the .step/.stp extension alone and fails with "unknown format... use --force-reader" unless told explicitly. Otherwise identical to 3d-model.json. Waydir ignores every key starting with "_".
_help_paging: 10 pages turning the model around its Z axis: --up=+Z makes Z the up axis, and %ANGLE% is 0, 36, 72 ... 324 degrees for pages 1-10 (PageUp/PageDown in Quick Look). Models authored Y-up (glTF by spec) will lie on their side with --up=+Z.
